blocks.text:
Upon arrival, meet your guide and transfer to the hotel. After arriving in Antigua (approximately 1 hour) – free time.

The old capital of Guatemala, Antigua (Antigua Guatemala), lies in the broad Pancho Valley, between the Agua, Acatenango, and Fuego volcanoes.

Founded in 1524, the city quickly became one of the largest cities of the Spanish Empire and served as the administrative center of all Central America. The city reached its peak in the mid-18th century. In 1773, Antigua was destroyed by the massive Santa Marta earthquake, which wiped out almost all buildings, monasteries, and architectural structures, many of which have now been restored and are museums. In 1979, Antigua was included in the UNESCO World Heritage List, and today it is the country's main tourist destination.
